value.rationale: Odd-ring frustration and removal of one coupled rung are naturally competing low-temperature phases. The theorem resolves all n>=3 and arbitrary positive inter-rung exchange with a nontrivial stable two-vacancy phase of coupling-independent width, exact coexistence and distinct parity behavior; these are physically interpretable, not a sample enumeration or automatic substitution. Singular decoupled-limit degeneracy further identifies the role of inter-rail locking.
